استخفين (form X)
# اِسْتَخْفَيْنَ (istaḵfayna) /is.tax.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخْفَى (istaḵfā)
# اِسْتَخْفِينَ (istaḵfīna) /is.tax.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْفَى (istaḵfā)
